title: Barry Johnson for ASA President
text:
Barry Johnson | Candidate for ASA President-Elect
I am nonresident fellow at the Urban-Brooking Tax Policy Center, where my research focuses on expanding access to data for evidence building, modernizing federal statistics, protecting data confidentiality, and improving tax administration.
With 37 years of experience at the Internal Revenue Service’s Statistics of Income Division (SOI) and a longstanding commitment to the statistical community, I have worked to modernize federal statistics, expand access to data, and advance responsible use of artificial intelligence.

title: Barry Johnson for ASA President
section: My Service to ASA and the Profession
text:
My Service to ASA and the Profession


Since attending my first Joint Statistical Meetings in 1988, I have been an active participant in ASA and the broader statistical community.

Link Lecture Award Committee: Served as chair from 2020–2023 chair from 2020–2023.
Committee on Gay and Lesbian Concerns in Statistics: Served for a decade, including as chair from 2005–2010.
Federal statistics policy and advocacy: Support for ASA activities focused on modernizing the federal statistical system, such as Modernizing the Federal Statistical System and Scientific Advisory Board for the Federal Statistics Project.

Professional leadership: Service with the National Tax Association and the National Bureau of Economic Research’s Conference on Research on Income and Wealth.
